08 / GullyGood · Founder & Builder

Good things shouldn't have to travel far.

GullyGood is one of the projects closest to my heart. I've been working on it for over a year, and watching it slowly turn from an idea into a real product has been an incredible experience. The idea is simple: connect people who want to donate with NGOs that need those resources, right in their neighbourhood. We're building a hyperlocal platform designed for cities like Mumbai, where donors can list items in a few steps and nearby NGOs can coordinate to receive them. We're currently developing the MVP and working towards a production-ready launch, exploring CSR partnerships and connecting with philanthropists to help bring GullyGood to life. Built for the neighbourhood. Made to do some good.
